summary: Backend regression testing for the production 500-fix (connection-pool starvation) on Somani Fabs. Added 19 new stability tests in /app/backend/tests/test_stability_fixes.py covering the display-state ETag/version optimisation, login stability, active sessions repeat load, session-detail fabric_b64 exclusion, /customers stats + xlsx export, and 20x hammer runs (sequential + 10-worker parallel) on settings, sessions/active, and display/state. All 19 new tests pass. All 23 pre-existing tests in backend_test.py still pass (42/42 total, ~110s including one real Gemini call).

minor.issue: When v matches and unchanged=true is returned, response omits idle_image too. If idle_image changes but a client keeps the previous version cached, it will still get unchanged. Because the version hash mixes trial ids + first 32 chars of idle_image this mostly works, but truncating to 32 chars means two different idle_images with identical first-32-chars would collide (rare, but possible with base64 headers like data:image/jpeg;base64,).

For each poll (when v mismatches) it does a separate db.trials.find_one() per preview inside a for-loop (N+1). With up to 8 previews this is 8 sequential Mongo round-trips. Consider $lookup or a single $in query.
(carried over from iter 1) datetime.fromisoformat(date).replace(tzinfo=IST) breaks if a full ISO datetime is supplied.
(carried over) Raw Dict body -> missing keys yield 500 instead of 422.

action_items: Optional: batch the per-preview db.trials.find_one() into a single $in query in display_state() for further payload/latency wins.
Optional: include a small hash of idle_image (full length or sha) rather than [:32] slice to avoid theoretical version collisions.
Optional: consider a Cache-Control/ETag HTTP header on /display/state so browsers/proxies can leverage 304 as well.
Carry-overs from iter 1 (still open): wrap raw Dict bodies in Pydantic; hide display_secret from non-super admins.
critical_code_review_comments: display_state() version scheme mixes trial_ids (order-preserving via sort updated_at asc) + first 32 chars of idle_image via md5 — correct in practice, but the [:32] slice on a base64 data URL means the first 32 chars are almost always 'data:image/jpeg;base64,/9j/4AAQ' which is identical across many jpegs. It works today only because idle_image changes are captured by trial_ids first. Consider hashing the full idle_image or its length+first-16+last-16 chars.
Mongo pool tuning (maxPoolSize=50, socketTimeoutMS=45000, retryWrites/reads) looks reasonable. Note: motor default is 100, so this is a REDUCTION; monitor in prod under high concurrency.
server.py is now 729 lines (up from ~640); splitting into modules (auth, sessions, trials, display, config, stats) is still recommended.
get_session() projection {'garments.fabric_b64': 0} correctly strips heavy field per document — verified by test that fabric_b64 is not in trial garments while generated_image + fabric_thumb remain.
seed_data_creation: Creates a TEST_Stability customer + one active session + one Gemini-generated trial + a live preview record. Fixture teardown clears the live preview and deletes the session (which also deletes trials). Customer record remains (no delete endpoint).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New stability tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_stability_fixes.py (uses module-scoped fixtures + xdist loadscope-safe). Both test files are pytest-xdist ready under pytest.ini (-n 2 --dist loadscope). Full suite runs in ~110s (Gemini calls dominate). If you add new tests that need the seeded session with a trial, reuse the seeded_session_with_trial fixture pattern. All 5xx checks in TestHammer will surface pool-starvation regressions.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verifies E1's fix for the intermittent-500 issue caused by /display/state returning full base64 images every 2s poll (up to 8 previews). The new ETag/version scheme was validated: (1) first call returns {version, previews[with images], idle_image}; (2) subsequent calls with matching ?v return {unchanged:true, version} in <2KB payload (no images); (3) mismatched or absent v returns full state; (4) sequential 20x + parallel 10-worker 20x runs on /display/state, /settings, /sessions/active all returned 200 with zero 5xx. The fabric_b64 exclusion on /sessions/{sid}.trials.garments was verified: generated_image and fabric_thumb are present, fabric_b64 is not. Login stability confirmed (200 for correct, 401 for wrong, 5 sequential logins all 200).
